subject: Exec alignment / VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>, Leah O'Connor <leah.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec alignment / VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive

Hi Jared & Leah,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great conversation and a clear fit around reducing inference cost for your real-time features. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key outcomes from today's discovery:
  • Primary use-case: real-time chat assistant in customer app (~150ms p95 target)
  • Volume estimate: ~200M tokens / month once in prod
  • Main constraints: latency SLOs, PCI/PII controls, and predictability for infra cost

Next steps I propose to unblock momentum: 
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) — to confirm SLA expectations, procurement path, and internal championing
2) Technical deep dive (dev/infra session) — 60m with our SE to validate architecture and surface any integration risks
3) Draft SOW & MA — attached initial mutual action plan and SOW draft for review

Jared, you mentioned Leah would want to be on the exec alignment call. Could we propose a quick VP/CTO intro next week? I can coordinate calendars — below are windows we have open:
- Tue 10 Mar: 09:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 11 Mar: 13:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 12 Mar: 09:00–12:00 PT

If those don't work, share 2–3 times that do and I will send a calendar invite. I’ve looped Dev and Vivek to schedule the technical deep dive once exec alignment is confirmed.

Attachments: Redwood_Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah O'Connor <leah.oconnor@acme.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec alignment / VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap.

Leah and I are aligned on the business goals; we also want to ensure we understand SLA options and the Dedicated deployment offering you mentioned. Leah, would you be able to join an exec intro next week? Our procurement lead (Samantha) is cc'd to begin thinking about timing for legal/contract steps.

Proposed from our side (all PT):
- Wed 11 Mar: 10:00–10:30 (exec sync)
- Thu 12 Mar: 10:00–10:30 (exec sync)

Either of those works — if you can send a calendar invite with a 30m slot and include a brief agenda (SLA / timeline / high-level commercial), that would be ideal.

On the tech side, we'd like the deep dive to cover KV cache behavior, batching, and integration with our tokenization pipeline.

Appreciate it — Jared
Jared Kim | Head of Product, Integrations
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>, Leah O'Connor <leah.oconnor@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec alignment / VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive

Perfect — thanks Jared. Thu 12 Mar 10:00 PT works for our execs as well. I’ll send a 30m invite for Thu 12 Mar 10:00–10:30 PT and include a short agenda: 1) Mutual goals & timeline, 2) SLA options (hosted vs dedicated), 3) high-level commercial ask.

Dev & Vivek — please plan to join the technical deep dive; we expect to schedule that for the week after the exec sync. Suggested agenda for the 60m tech session:
- Architecture review & integration points (10m)
- Inference runtime / latency guarantees & quantization options (20m)
- KV cache / batching behavior and tokenization integration (20m)
- Open questions & next steps (10m)

Jared — I’ll include Samantha on the SOW/MA thread and attach the draft for initial review. Expect the calendar invite and a DocuSign link for an NDA-lite / MA to follow.

—Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Exec alignment / VP/CTO intro and technical deep dive (internal)

Thanks — I'm available Thu 12 Mar 09:30–12:00 PT and Fri 13 Mar 13:00–16:00 PT for the deep dive.

I’ll prepare a short demo of KV cache behavior and some latency numbers from our Hosted and Dedicated profiles. Also will bring a simple diagram showing where your tokenization pipeline would integrate. If you have a sample tokenization snippet or preferred tokenizer (SentencePiece/BPE), please send prior to the session so we can validate locally.
